hooks.command: bash -lc 'fail() { printf "firstmate Codex hook refused: %s\n" "$1" >&2; exit 2; }; payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "shasum is unavailable"; if [ -n "${FM_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT:-}" ]; then root=$(cd "$FM_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || fail "configured trusted code root is unavailable"; else root=$(pwd -P) || fail "hook working directory is unavailable"; fi; manifest="$root/.codex/hook-payload.sha256"; [ -f "$manifest" ] && [ ! -L "$manifest" ] || fail "trusted payload manifest is missing or unsafe"; manifest_line=$(shasum -a 256 "$manifest" 2>/dev/null) || fail "trusted payload manifest cannot be hashed"; manifest_hash=${manifest_line%% *}; [ "$manifest_hash" = "851da92578af753f2927e123ae162f8d712f274a3d48e4fff389b0237f8c4829" ] || fail "trusted payload manifest hash mismatch"; while read -r expected file; do [ -n "$expected" ] && [ -n "$file" ] && [ -f "$root/$file" ] && [ ! -L "$root/$file" ] || fail "trusted payload entry is missing or unsafe"; done < "$manifest"; verify=$(cd "$root" && shasum -a 256 -c -q --strict .codex/hook-payload.sha256 2>&1) || fail "trusted payload hash mismatch: $verify"; [ -x "$root/bin/fm-sessionstart-nudge.sh" ] || fail "trusted session-start payload is not executable"; exec "$root/bin/fm-sessionstart-nudge.sh"'
